descriptionChirho: Cultivable land or territory belonging to a people or person; homeland, country, or promised land as a geographic/political entity.
The physical material of the earth — soil, clay, or dust — from which man was formed and to which he returns; the ground as raw substance rather than territory.
The surface of the ground as a location where things fall, rest, or are placed; the earth beneath one's feet.
Agricultural land or cultivated fields producing crops; the ground as productive soil for farming.
Multiple territories or countries; used in the plural to refer to various nations or regions.
